import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Top Products by Revenue
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color=colors[:len(product_revenue)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top Products by Revenue', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, bar in enumerate(bars1):
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax1.text(width, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${width:,.0f}', 
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 2. Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group and Payment Method
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack()
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment = age_payment.reindex(age_order)
age_payment.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, stacked=False, width=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sales by Age Group and Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Payment Method', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9, loc='upper left')
ax2.set_xticklabels(ax2.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Average Transaction Value by Size and Takeaway Status
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_takeaway = df.groupby(['size', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].mean().unstack()
size_takeaway.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_takeaway = size_takeaway.reindex(size_order)
x = np.arange(len(size_order))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax3.bar(x - width/2, size_takeaway['Dine-in'], width, label='Dine-in', color='#3498db')
bars2 = ax3.bar(x + width/2, size_takeaway['Takeaway'], width, label='Takeaway', color='#e74c3c')
ax3.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Size and Service Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.set_xticks(x)
ax3.set_xticklabels(size_order)
ax3.legend(fontsize=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Daily Sales Trend
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
daily_sales = df.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()
ax4.plot(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['total'], color='#2ecc71', linewidth=2, marker='o', markersize=3)
ax4.fill_between(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['total'], alpha=0.3, color='#2ecc71')
ax4.set_xlabel('Date', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Daily Sales Trend', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add summary statistics box
total_revenue = df['total'].sum()
total_transactions = len(df)
avg_transaction = df['total'].mean()
textstr = f'Total Revenue: ${total_revenue:,.2f}\nTransactions: {total_transactions:,}\nAvg Transaction: ${avg_transaction:.2f}'
props = dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.8)
ax4.text(0.02, 0.97, textstr, transform=ax4.transAxes, fontsize=10,
         verticalalignment='top', bbox=props, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
